NO-TRADE BAND, activated 2026-09-06. Replaces the rebalance_days calendar: the signal is recomputed every session and a position is left alone unless it is more than 4.8% (in weight) from target, then traded back to the BAND EDGE, not to target. Constantinides (1986), Davis & Norman (1990). DERIVED, NOT OPTIMISED: the cube-root law h* = (3c.sigma_w^2/2.kappa_w)^(1/3) on measured target-weight dynamics (sigma_w=0.04083/day, phi_w=0.95280 => kappa_w=0.04835, half-life 14.3d) gives 4.26% at 15bp and 4.85% at 22bp; the cube-root scaling verifies exactly (h(30bp)/h(15bp)=1.260 vs 2^(1/3)=1.2599). 4.8% is the derived width at a mid-range cost estimate AND the lower edge of the measured plateau (4.8-9.6%). 6.4% topped the swept column and was NOT chosen -- selecting the argmax of a sweep is how z_window=63 was picked, and it failed out of sample. Measured full sample: gross 1.16, turnover 17.6x/yr (vs 31.1 on the calendar), net@15bp 0.66 (vs 0.33), and net@30bp +0.17 where EVERY calendar configuration goes negative.
